verdict.rationale: Sill is free and open source. It has no account and no vendor server: the host runs on your own Mac, and the stream travels only between your own devices. Remote use goes through your own VPN or a port you forward. You can build the app from source, sign it with your own identity and bundle ID, or run the host headless with `swift run -c release SillHost`. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that a from-source, self-run build works end to end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Sill is free and open source.
There is no account and no server: your screen and what you type travel only between your own devices
`swift run -c release SillHost` runs the same host on the command line
This builds Sill.app with SwiftPM, signs it with your Apple Development identity, replaces /Applications/Sill.app and opens it.
Remote Access lets you use your Mac away from home, through your own VPN, such as Tailscale, or through a port you forward on your router.
